rationale.conceptual: GDQ discretization of orthotropic plate governing equations for three theories (CLPT, FSDT, HSDT) and two boundary conditions requires careful implementation of the method and assembly of the eigenvalue problem, though the method itself is well-documented.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has only two main steps: compute effective material properties (rule of mixture) and run the GDQ eigenvalue solver for 144 parameter combinations, outputting a single CSV. Standard libraries (NumPy/SciPy) suffice; no complex orchestration or data fetching.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires implementing the GDQ method for three plate theories with given material properties from the rule of mixture. The method is established but non-trivial; the pipeline is simple with few steps. No GPU needed, minimal data.

compute_estimate.reasoning: GDQ discretization yields small matrices (grid sizes ~7–9 points) for eigenvalue problems; the 144 cases are solved sequentially on CPU with negligible data.
